name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

models.description:
Which {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s to classify. If specified, it will take precedence over
{@link #modelFilter} and {@link #trainJobRun}.

modelFilter.description:
{@link Filter} for fetching {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s to classify.
It will be only used if {@link #models} is not specified, and it overrides the {@link #trainJobRun}.

trainJobRun.description:
{@link MlModel.Train.JobRun} for fetching {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s to classify.
It will be only used if neither {@link #models} nor {@link #modelFilter} is specified.

referencePeriod.description:
Reference period to use for model classification. If specified, the same value
will be applied to all the models specified by {@link #models}, {@link #modelFilter} and {@link #trainJobRun}.
If this field is not specified, a default will be set for each model based on {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun#trainFeatureTimeRanges}.

comparisonPeriod.description:
Comparison period to use for model classification. If specified, the same value
will be applied to all the models specified by {@link #models}, {@link #modelFilter} and {@link #trainJobRun}.
If this field is not specified, a default will be set for each model based on {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun#valFeatureTimeRanges}.

evaluationSpec.description: The {@link MlModel.Evaluation.Spec} that should be used for model evaluation.

spec.description: The {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel.ClassificationScoreSpec} that should be used for model classification.

isMonitoring.description:
Specify whether this {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.ModelClassification} instance is being used to monitor a model, or is being
used for model classification.

name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.ModelClassification
